URL: https://app.emplaihrms.com

Worked example: Enter santoshbabu.p@kapilit.com in the identifier field, the account password in the password field, then click the primary submit button. On first login the app redirects to /profile/1/self/2/9 (My Profile → Basic Information) and shows a one-time "Update Your Profile Photo" dialog with two choices — Upload Photo or Do it later. 3. Role-Based Access

The same left-hand menu shows different sections depending on who is logged in. Based on the "My Data" vs "Team" vs admin-only tiles observed in the app, access breaks down into these roles:

Access matrix (inferred from the menu structure of this account)

Module / ScreenEmployee (Self)ManagerHR AdminPayroll AdminSystem Admin
Dashboard, Check-In/Out✅✅✅✅✅
Request (raise own)✅✅✅✅✅
Inbox (approve team requests)—✅✅—✅
Leave / Attendance → My Data✅✅✅✅✅
Leave / Attendance → Team—✅✅—✅
Employees (master list, onboarding, notice/probation)——✅view-only✅
Payroll → My Data (own salary/YTD)✅✅view-only✅✅
Payroll → Employees / Approvals / PayRuns / Challans——view-only✅✅
Settings (all tiles)——partial (Leave/Attendance tiles)partial (Payroll tile)✅ full

✅ = full access observed/expected for that role; — = not shown in that role's menu; "view-only" / "partial" = likely read access or a subset of tiles, based on how the module is split into My Data / Team / Admin sections. This matrix reflects the menu structure seen while testing as a single account and should be confirmed against your organization's actual role configuration in Settings → Users.

5. Request Module Self-service

TabShows
PendingRequests you raised, awaiting a decision. Table columns appear once data exists: Request Type, Date Raised, Status, Approver.
ApprovedYour requests that were approved, with approver & approval date.
RejectedYour requests that were declined, typically with a rejection remark.

Add Request opens a type picker (Leave, Attendance Regularization, etc., depending on what your organization has configured) and routes to a dedicated form per type — e.g. selecting Leave opens the same calendar-based form reachable from Leave → Apply Leave (detailed below).

Worked example — Applying for Leave (via Request or Leave module)

  1. Go to Leave → My Data → Leave Summary (or Request → Add Request) and click Apply Leave.
  2. A calendar opens. Click a start day, e.g. 10 (10‑Aug‑2026). The panel shows "Select an end date to complete range".
  3. Click the end day, e.g. 11 (11‑Aug‑2026). The form on the right auto-fills:
    • From Date: 2026-08-10   To Date: 2026-08-11   Total days: 2
    • Start Date (10‑Aug‑2026): radio — Full Day / Second Half
    • End Date (11‑Aug‑2026): radio — Full Day / First Half
  4. Leave Type (required dropdown, searchable) — in this tenant only Loss Of Pay (LOP) is configured (see screenshot below), because no paid-leave policies have been set up yet.
  5. Available Balance — a link, "Check your available balance", next to the Leave Type field.
  6. Comments (required, free text) — e.g. "Travelling to hometown for a family function."
  7. Attachment (optional file upload) — e.g. attach a supporting document/medical certificate.
  8. Click Submit. The request moves to Request → Pending and simultaneously to the approver's Inbox → Pending.

Calendar color legend observed: Present (green), Absent (red), Comp Off (purple), Holiday (blue), Week Off (yellow), On Leave (orange), Selected (dark purple), Range (light purple). Note shown: "Only Absent dates (Past or future) are Allowed" — i.e. you can only file leave against days currently marked Absent.
